Stand Tall at Trade Shows and Events With Retractable Banners

When it comes to trade shows, bazaars, and conferences, standing out in a sea of guests and fellow exhibitors can be a challenge. Retractable banners can help you stand out in the crowd and capture the attention of potential customers with a bright vinyl banner propped up on a tall, metal frame.

Types of Retractable Banners and Display Options


Types of Retractable Banners Display Options Graphic Sizes
Standard Retractable Banner comes with one single-sided printed banner and metal stand. 23.5” x 80”, 33.5” x 80”, and 47” x 80”
Deluxe Retractable Banner choose between one single-sided banner or two banners you can set up back-to-back to create a double-sided view;
both options come with a metal stand.		 33”x 77” only
Premium Retractable Banner comes with one single-sided printed banner and metal stand. 24” x 88”, 36” x 88”, 48” x 88”, and 60” x 88”
Outdoor Retractable Banner wind-resistant banner with double-sided visibility.
perfect for a diverse outdoor setting 		33.5” x 60”, 33.5” x 72”, and 33.5” x 80”

Material/Substrate Options

13 oz Smooth Matte Vinyl

Smooth vinyl material perfect for indoor use. Available for standard retractable banners.

18 oz. Heavy Duty Vinyl

Thicker and denser vinyl material that’s specifically used for outdoor use. Can withstand harsh winds and challenging weather conditions. Available for outdoor retractable banners.

UV Fabric

Heavy-duty fabric banner with gray backing made with tightly woven threads. Suitable for both indoor and outdoor use. Available with Deluxe and Premium retractable banner variants.

A Guide to Picking the Right Retractable Banner Size

Our retractable banners come in various types and sizes to help you gauge the signage’s fit against the space you’re setting up in. Use the guide below to select the right pop-up banner for you.

Standard Retractable Banners

23.5” x 80”

Our smallest retractable banner available; great for limited floor spaces.

23.5” x 80”

Our most popular banner size and has adequate space for images and text.

47” x 80”

Our largest size for standard retractable banner; ideal for big booths.


Deluxe Retractable Banners

 

 

33” x 77”

The deluxe banner comes in one size that fits the deluxe base. Great for symposiums, and indoor events.


Premium Retractable Banners

24” x 88”

The sleek banner size that fits in tight, minimal spaces without compromising visibility.

36” x 88”

Versatile size that sets the standard for premium banners. Perfect for trade shows and promotional campaigns.

48” x 88”

This wide-format retractable banner provides more space for bolder images and product info. Great for sales and retail.

 

 

60” x 88”

You get an extra-wide premium banner with this size. Designed for maximum visibility at any distance.


Outdoor Retractable Banners

33.5” x 60”

The standard outdoor banner size for sidewalk promotions and outdoor events.

33.5” x 72”

The extra height adds better visibility in outdoor settings. Perfect for fairs and markets.

33.5” x 80”

The tallest outdoor pop-up banner is equally resilient, built to withstand outdoor conditions while maximizing brand awareness.


Retractable Banners FAQs

If you have a print-ready file, you can upload it to our site by clicking the “UPLOAD YOUR FILE & ORDER NOW” button. Please ensure that your file is not larger than 200 mb, is set to CMYK color settings, and has a minimum resolution of 300 dpi. We also accept the following file formats: PDF, JPG, JPEG, PSD, PNG, TIF, TIFF, EPS, Illustrator, Publisher, DOCX, DOC, XLS, XLSX. PPT, PPTX, TXT, CSV, BMP, GIF, and SVG.

You can also use our online design tool for free if you want to create a banner design from scratch. With our online design tool, you can upload images from your computer, add graphics and text, and use your preferred fonts. Finally, we have free design templates you can modify according to your brand colors and elements to come up with a banner.

Please note that every order of our retractable banners include the banner itself and a stand. What is the difference between standard, premium, and deluxe retractable banners? Our standard, deluxe, and retractable premium banners are different from each other in a number of ways — sizes, substrate options, and display options.

Yes. Our retractable banners can be printed in either 13 oz. vinyl material or UV fabric material, both of which are weather-proof and can be used outdoors. Please note that it’s strongly recommended to put away the banner during extreme weather conditions.

Check that the banner retracts and extends smoothly and that the base is stable on a flat surface. Make sure all parts, including the support pole and feet, are properly positioned and the banner is straight without wrinkles.

Set up your file at the final banner size using the correct template and CMYK color mode, and use high-resolution images. You can also use our banner font size tool to choose readable text sizes.
